lede: Yose Power sells e-bike conversion kits, replacement e-bike batteries and spare parts from yosepower.com, shipped from a warehouse in Berlin. Here's what it sells, what customers say about it, and whether it's worth the money.

parts: Yes, Yose Power is a real company that has sold e-bike batteries and kits since 2011, by its own account, with a warehouse in Berlin and an EU hub in Frankfurt. It holds 4.3 out of 5 on Trustpilot from 177 reviews. Most buyers are happy with the kits and the delivery, but about one review in four is 1 star, mostly about faulty batteries or chargers and slow email support.

Conversion kits turn a normal bike into an e-bike: a wheel with a hub motor built in, a controller, a display, a pedal sensor and, in most kits, a battery and charger. Yose Power sells front and rear kits for 20" to 28" wheels, from €219 for a 20" front kit without a battery to €459 for the A3 Pro rear kit with a torque sensor. It also sells replacement 36V batteries for down tubes and rear racks (from €186) and spare parts like displays, controllers, brake sensors and pedal sensors.

parts: Happy reviewers mention fast delivery, kits that are easy to fit, tools in the box, and support that answers technical questions within a day or two. Several are on their second or third kit, and one says a kit lasted 23,000 km. The 1-star reviews are worth reading before you buy: batteries that wouldn't charge or never reached full charge, a faulty replacement charger and a warranty dispute, and complaints that support is by email only and slow. One buyer was unhappy that no kit fit their bike.

Yes. It sells through its own site as well as Amazon and eBay, says it has run its own ISO 9001 certified factory since 2017, and lists warehouses in Germany, the UK and the US. It publishes its shipping, returns, warranty and repair prices, ships every parcel with tracking, and accepts PayPal, cards and Klarna. Its contact is email only (service@yosepower.com, Monday to Saturday), with no phone number, which some reviewers dislike.

A kit with a battery costs €379 to €459, a fraction of a new e-bike, if you're happy to fit it yourself or pay a bike shop. The battery prices are also fair for the capacity: the 20Ah Hailong pack gives 740Wh for €259. The risk is after-sales: if a battery fails, you deal with Yose Power by email, and you pay shipping on warranty parts. Check that your local e-bike rules allow the motor power and top speed you pick; the 250W kits list 25 km/h, the 350W kits 30 to 32 km/h. Our [Yose Power discount code guide](saving-tips-yose-power-discount-code.html) lists every way to pay less, with prices side by side.

Is Yose Power worth it?
For a DIY e-bike, mostly yes: kits with a battery cost €379 to €459. The risk is support if a battery fails: it's by email only, and some reviewers waited a long time.
What is Yose Power's Trustpilot rating?
4.3 out of 5 from 177 reviews on November 21, 2026: 110 five-star and 41 one-star.

Its rear rack battery is rated 4.9 from 55 reviews and its Hailong down tube battery 4.7 from 30 on yosepower.com. Most 1-star Trustpilot reviews are about batteries that didn't charge fully, so test yours as soon as it arrives.
What is the Yose Power A3 Pro?
A 36V 250W 26" rear cassette motor kit with a torque sensor in the motor, a 7Ah (252Wh) battery and a colour display, for €459 on November 21, 2026.
What does Yose Power sell?
E-bike conversion kits for 20" to 28" wheels, 36V replacement batteries for down tubes and rear racks, and spare parts like displays, controllers and sensors.
Where is Yose Power based?
Its shop ships from a warehouse in Berlin, and it lists an EU hub in Frankfurt, plus warehouses in the UK and the US and offices in Hong Kong, the US and Germany.
What is Yose Power's warranty?
12 to 18 months from purchase: 18 months on its down tube batteries and 12 months on chargers. Defective parts are replaced, but you pay the shipping.
What is Yose Power's return policy?
30 days for new, unused products in their original packaging. Sale items can't be returned, and you pay return shipping.
